name: Čechtice (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, red and white in the ratio 1:3:1, with a white fleur-de-lis in the centre of the red stripe.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 April 2008 (decision No. 30) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
